blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Cebu Provincial Government needs ₱11.174 billion to rehabilitate infrastructure and public facilities damaged by Typhoon Tino, with infrastructure accounting for the largest share of the estimated recovery requirements. According to the Province’s post-disaster assessment, ₱5.1 billion is needed for infrastructure recovery. Provincial records separately listed ₱2.3 billion for roads, ₱1.9 billion for bridges and footbridges, and ₱737 million for slope protection. The records also identified ₱137 million for barangay health centers and ₱1 billion for schools affected by the typhoon.
